text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At this year's Takarazuka Kinen, a multitude of hopes and desires will meet to face off on the track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One racer wants to find her own way of running, another wants to stand as a preventative wall, while the third wants to overleap that wall.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright steps out onto the turf at Hanshin, determined to face the new generation of racing.
